name: Browser Interactions with Playwright
description: This test suite verifies that the tests are run correctly and that they cover the required functionality.

tests.name: Run tests and extract traces
tests.description: Run the Playwright tests and extract traces for further analysis. Passing this step does not guarantee that your tests covered the required functionality, which is checked by the subsequent tests.
